turns.q: Hi! I'm looking for a gift for someone and I'm not sure what to pick, can you help?
turns.replyTail:
Tria Virtual Assistant! How can I help you today?
Fiona: Of course. We offer hair-removal and skin-resurfacing lasers. The right choice depends on the recipient’s needs, and hair-removal suitability depends on their skin tone and hair colour. You can browse our product guides here: [Tria Guides](https://www.trialaser.com/pages/tria-guides). For the Hair Removal Laser 4X, it is suitable for light to medium skin tones and naturally dark hair; it is not suitable for blonde, red, grey or white hair.
